extracted.intended_audience: Trademark applicants and their attorneys/agents preparing a TEAS Response to a USPTO Office Action
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and mandatory requirements for completing the USPTO TEAS 'Response to Office Action' form, including what information, attestations, attachments, signature methods, and procedural steps are required for filing a response to a trademark examining attorney. Applicable to owners, representatives, and filing agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material alteration prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: While minor changes in the mark are sometimes permitted, any material alteration will NOT be permitted and will result in a refusal being issued on that ground.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have read and understood the above notice, you must check this box before you enter the proposed amended mark. Material alterations to the mark are grounds for refusal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark type selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Click the appropriate circle to indicate the Mark type: Standard Characters, Special Form (Stylized and/or Design), Sound Mark.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Standard Characters' for word(s)/letter(s)/punctuation/numbers with no design element and no claim to font style, size or color. If you object to the USPTO-generated image for standard characters, use 'Special Form', attach your own image file and check the box to claim standard characters; the appropriateness of that claim will be determined during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner name formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: [If an individual, use the following format: Last Name, First Name Middle Initial or Name, if applicable]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide DBA/TA/Formerly/AKA as applicable. Use the specified format for individuals to ensure correct database storage and correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entity type identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Select an Entity Type for the owner: Individual, Corporation, Limited Liability Company, Partnership, Limited Partnership, Joint Venture, Sole Proprietorship, Trust, Estate, Other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accurately identify the legal entity type as it appears in the application record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address/storage character limits
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: You must limit your entry here, and for all remaining fields within this overall section (except City, see below), to no more than 40 characters (the storage limit for the USPTO database). You must limit your entry here to no more than 22 characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abbreviate words (e.g., 'St.' for 'Street') to avoid truncation. Failure to do so may result in an undeliverable address due to truncation. For City, include geographical region if needed (e.g., 'Toronto, Ontario').

rubrics_metrics.name: Country and ZIP required for U.S. owners
rubrics_metrics.description: * Country of Citizenship / * Country or U.S. Territory / * Zip/Postal Code (Required for U.S. owners/holders only)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply country and ZIP/postal code as required; fields are mandatory for U.S. owners/holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single correspondence email policy
rubrics_metrics.description: While the application may list an e-mail address for the owner, owner's attorney, and/or owner's domestic representative, only one e-mail address may be used for correspondence, in accordance with USPTO policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The owner must keep this address current. Check the box to authorize USPTO to communicate via e-mail. Applicant is solely responsible for receipt of USPTO documents sent via e-mail; check TSDR for actions; USPTO not responsible for non-receipt due to applicant's or agent's systems or anti-spam.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing of goods/services — content rules
rubrics_metrics.description: * Listing of Goods/Services/Collective Membership Organization [Do not enter a Class or any other code in the field below. You must enter only the common commercial name for the specific goods/services/nature of the collective membership organization associated with the mark. Also, do not include any html or other programming code or language that may create links in the listing of goods/recitation of services/description of the collective membership organization].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If entering multiple listings, separate with a semicolon (;), NOT a comma. For acceptable language, see USPTO's on-line Goods and/or Services Manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope limitation on goods/services
rubrics_metrics.description: WARNING: Your entry may NOT exceed the scope of your current identification. While you may modify the current listing to clarify or limit the goods/services/nature of the collective membership organization or to remove goods/services, you may NOT at this point ADD to, or BROADEN, the goods/services/nature of the collective membership organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To cover any new or broader goods/services, a new filing is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fraudulent statements warning
rubrics_metrics.description: WARNING: Registration Subject to Cancellation for Fraudulent Statements. Statements made in filings to the USPTO must be accurate; inaccuracies could result in the cancellation of a trademark registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: an owner's/holder's lack of bona fide intention to use the mark with all goods/services included, or lack of use on all goods/services for which use is claimed, could jeopardize registration validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Basis Section 1(a) — Use in Commerce
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing Basis Section 1(a), Use in Commerce: The mark is in use in commerce and was in use in commerce as of the application filing date. The provided specimen shows the mark in use in commerce (see specimen statement below).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you filed originally under Section 1(b) and now want to assert use, do not use this form to submit dates of use and a specimen unless responding to a specimen issue created by an already filed Allegation of Use. Use the specific Allegation of Use form otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date format for first use fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of First Use of Mark Anywhere at least as early as (MM/DD/YYYY); Date of First Use of Mark in Commerce at least as early as (MM/DD/YYYY).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter dates in MM/DD/YYYY format. Ensure accuracy and consistency with specimens and filing basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen file formats and size limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Click on the 'Attach' button to select the file in JPG/PDF format (not exceeding 5 megabytes per attachment) or .WAV, .WMV, .WMA, .MP3, .MPG, or .AVI format (not exceeding 5 megabytes for sound files or 30 megabytes for motion files).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do NOT submit your entire filing as a PDF file. Each portion of this form serves a specific purpose for data processing reasons. FAILURE TO FOLLOW THIS INSTRUCTION WILL CAUSE SIGNIFICANT DELAYS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen statement for substitute/new/unverified specimens
rubrics_metrics.description: CLICK BOX BELOW IF SPECIMENS ARE BEING SUBMITTED OR WERE UNVERIFIED IN THE INITIAL APPLICATION: ... You must select the specimen statement below for the substitute, new, or originally submitted unverified specimen to be acceptable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the specific statement referenced in the Office action (options for Section 1(a) use; Section 1(b) timing; or 'true copy' for illegible specimens). The signatory is warned that willful false statements are punishable under 18 U.S.C. §1001 and may jeopardize the validity of the application/registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Basis Section 1(b) — Intent to Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing Basis Section 1(b), Intent to Use: The applicant believes the applicant is entitled to use the mark in commerce on or in connection with the goods or services specified; the applicant has a bona fide intention to use the mark in commerce and had a bona fide intention as of the application filing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For collective/certification marks, applicant must have bona fide intention and legitimate entitlement to exercise control. WARNING: If your goods/services for this class are already based on Section 1(a), do not also check this basis for identical goods/services. Selecting 1(b) means additional filings and fees will be required after beginning use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Basis Section 44(d) — Priority on foreign filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing Basis Section 44(d), Priority based on foreign filing: Applicant believes it is entitled to use the mark in commerce and asserts a claim of priority based upon a foreign application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements parallel to Section 1(b) regarding bona fide intention and, for collective/certification marks, legitimate control and non-production for certification marks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Basis Section 44(e) — Based on foreign registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing Basis Section 44(e), Based on Foreign Registration: The applicant attaches a copy of the foreign registration certificate or proof of renewal of such registration, and an English translation if such documents are in a foreign language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant must meet the same entitlement and bona fide intention statements as for other bases. Attach required foreign registration paperwork in acceptable file formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign application field length limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: The USPTO database can only store 12 characters for this field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust entries (e.g., remove leading zeros or country abbreviations) to fit the 12-character storage limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee information and calculations
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount: number of Classes Paid x $325 (per class) for Application fee for TEAS form = $; number of Payments Refused or charged back x $50 for Additional processing fee for each payment refused or charged back = $; TOTAL AMOUNT = $
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate fees accurately based on number of classes and any processing fees for refused payments.

rubrics_metrics.name: New correspondence info — field limits and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: * Name, Firm Name, Docket/Reference Number, Internal Address, * Street Address, * City, * State, * Country or U.S. Territory, * Zip/Postal Code, Phone Number, Fax Number, Primary Email Address, Secondary Email Address(es).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the same character limits (40 chars generally, 22 for City) and keep correspondence email current. Enter up to 4 addresses separated by semicolon or comma; only one email used for official correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration signature requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If a declaration is required, the declaration must be signed by someone who is a 'proper party to sign on behalf of the applicant' under Trademark Rule 2.33. Click to choose ONE signature method: Sign electronically directly on this response form; E-mail Text Form to second party for electronic signature; Handwritten pen-and-ink signature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To electronically sign, enter any alpha/numeric characters of your choosing, preceded and followed by the forward slash (/) symbol (e.g., /john doe/; /jd/; /123-4567/). The Response Signature information must always be entered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signatory title/position guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: Enter the appropriate title or the nature of the relationship to the owner/holder - if an individual, enter 'Owner' or 'Holder'; if an attorney, enter 'Attorney of record, [specify at least one state] bar member'; if an authorized signatory of a business entity enter, e.g., 'President,' 'Vice President,' 'General Partner', or 'Principal'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broad designations such as 'Authorized Signatory' and 'Trademark Administrator' are not acceptable. If associate attorney not of record, include firm name to establish acceptability (e.g., 'Associate Attorney, Smith, Jones & Davis, Virginia Bar Member').

rubrics_metrics.name: Attestations for unsigned Section 1(a) application/AOU
rubrics_metrics.description: STATEMENTS FOR UNSIGNED SECTION 1(a) APPLICATION/AOU: If the applicant filed an unsigned application under 15 U.S.C. §1051(a) or AOU under 15 U.S.C. §1051(c), the signatory additionally believes that: the applicant is the owner of the mark; the mark is in use in commerce and was in use as of the filing date; the original specimen(s) shows the mark in use; for collective marks, the applicant is exercising legitimate control; for a certification mark, the applicant is not engaged in production or marketing except to advertise or promote recognition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signatory must believe these facts to be true; willful false statements punishable under 18 U.S.C. §1001 and may jeopardize validity of application/registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attestations for unsigned Section 1(b)/44/66(a) filings
rubrics_metrics.description: STATEMENTS FOR UNSIGNED SECTION 1(b)/SECTION 44 APPLICATION AND FOR SECTION 66(a) COLLECTIVE/CERTIFICATION MARK APPLICATION: If the applicant filed an unsigned application under 15 U.S.C. §§ 1051(b), 1126(d), and/or 1126(e), or filed a collective/certification mark application under 15 U.S.C. §1141f(a), the signatory additionally believes that: the applicant is entitled to use the mark; the applicant has a bona fide intention to use the mark and had that intention as of the filing date; the signatory is properly authorized to execute the declaration; for certification marks, the applicant will not engage in production or marketing except to advertise/recognize certification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signatory must be properly authorized to execute declaration; false statements carry criminal penalties under 18 U.S.C. §1001.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation checkboxes and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: * Unrepresented Owner/Holder: I hereby confirm that No authorized attorney or Canadian attorney/agent represents me ... ADVISORY: You may click this first button only if you are the owner/holder or legally authorized to bind the owner/holder. * Authorized U.S. Attorney: I hereby confirm that I am an attorney who is a member in good standing of the bar of the highest court of a U.S. state ... * Authorized Canadian Attorney/Agent: I hereby confirm that I am a Canadian attorney/agent ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a prior representative existed, the new attorney must confirm filing of revocation/substitute power or that USPTO granted withdrawal, or that a power of attorney appointing the new attorney has been filed. Foreign attorneys (other than authorized Canadian attorneys/agents) may not sign this form and are prohibited from representing an owner/holder before the USPTO in trademark matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Only one signature required; multiple owners
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: Only one signature is required, regardless of the number of owners/holders. The person signing for each section may be different, depending on who has the required knowledge to sign. To add a signature option, if appropriate, use the 'Add Signatory' button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the person signing has the required knowledge and authority for the statements being made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation page review and final submission checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Validation Page: On __________________ you completed all mandatory fields and successfully validated the form. It has NOT been filed to the USPTO at this point. STEP 1: Review the Response data... STEP 2: If any information is incorrect, click Go Back to Modify... STEP 3: If there are no errors and you are ready to file this Response electronically, confirm the e-mail address for acknowledgment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is critical to confirm that all information is displayed properly immediately before filing. If any previously-entered argument text or image files are missing, re-enter or re-attach before final submission, or the USPTO will not receive that text/evidence. Note about characters: after submission some characters may be displayed differently; USPTO will convert problematic characters to closest acceptable equivalents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response data outputs and downloadable file instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Response Data: Input, Evidence(s), Mark, XML File, Textform. STEP 4: To download and save the Response, click on the Download Portable Data button at the bottom of this page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Saved data is in .obj/.xml; to begin submission with saved data, open a new form and use the 'Browse/Choose File' button on the initial wizard page to import. REMINDER: Do NOT try to open the saved .obj/.xml form directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgment email entry
rubrics_metrics.description: STEP 3: confirm the e-mail address for acknowledgment. Once you submit a Response electronically, we will send an electronic acknowledgment of receipt to the e-mail address entered below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This e-mail address is only for receiving acknowledgment the transmission reached USPTO and is not necessarily the official correspondence e-mail (which is whatever appears in the record). For multiple addresses/receipts, separate addresses with a semicolon or comma.
